description: Compare_Ignore_Punctuation (and Compare_Standard with any fully ignorable character) answered Less for "" vs "-": an empty-string shortcut ran before the weights, although punctuation is documented as ignorable at all levels (own sort-key test; silent shortcut, pattern 2)

Encode_DPCM/Decode_DPCM clamped differences and reconstructions to 16 bits, so Decode (Encode ([32767, -32768])) = [32767, -1] although the spec calls DPCM the foundation of lossless codecs; tests.adb Test 10 asserted the clamped delta (own exact round-trip test; clamp, pattern 1). Fixed with modulo 2**16 wraparound

Solve_Abelian_HSP returned N / r (a generator of the annihilator of H in the dual group) instead of a generator of the hidden subgroup H = r Z_N promised by the spec: for f (x) = x mod 4 on Z_12 it returned 3 and Verify_Hidden_Subgroup (12, [3], f) = False; tests.adb Test 6 asserted the wrong value 3 ("12/4 = 3"); Test 5 (Z_9, period 3) passed only because 9 / 3 = 3 (own certificate test; pattern 5, demo-value coincidence)

Solve_Period_Finding searched r in 1 .. N - 1 and raised Subgroup_Not_Found for a one-to-one oracle, although r = N satisfies f (x) = f (x + r) on Z_N (spec: smallest positive such r); the trivial hidden subgroup {0} could not be found (own known-subgroup test; silent failure path, pattern 2)

Solve_Simons_Problem: the named GF(2) part (equation collection + Gaussian_Elimination + Dot_Product) is never reached for a valid oracle, because a brute-force search for f (i) = f (0) returns s first; removing that loop makes the own checks fail at once (n = 1, s = 1: Subgroup_Not_Found), and the elimination solves for vectors orthogonal to the collision differences, i.e. it would not return s (e.g. s = 5 -> 2). Pattern 7 (fallback hides the named algorithm); 24 mutants in that code all survive (0/4 Dot_Product, 0/13 Gaussian_Elimination). Decision (Robert, 19:56): fix, do not hide. Fixed: Simon_Sample_Equations simulates the quantum sampling exactly and Gaussian_Elimination + Simon_Null_Vector read s from the RREF null space; no collision search left in the solver

Modular_Exponentiation started from Result = 1, so x**0 mod 1 returned 1 instead of 0, violating its own postcondition Result < Modulus (own repeated-multiplication reference over base 0..24, exponent 0..24, modulus 1..24; initial-value shortcut, pattern 2)

named phase does not sort; output correct only via fallback bubble sort: Samplesort_Phase returned untouched for fewer than Num_Buckets (8) elements and its bucket sorts were not proved, so Sort was correct (and proved) only through the final Bubble_Finish; tests/phase_alone.sh (own property checks with the Bubble_Finish call removed) failed at N = 2 (fallback hides the named algorithm, pattern 7). Fixed with in-place buckets whose sortedness is proved; Bubble_Finish removed

Recognize, Parse and Parse_Weighted read Input (S_Idx) for S_Idx in 1 .. N, so an Input_String whose index range does not start at 1 (a slice, or Input_String (7 .. 8)) raised Constraint_Error (cyk_algorithm.adb:50) or read the wrong symbols; the spec allows any Positive range

named phase does not sort; output correct only via fallback bubble sort: Samplesort_Phase returned untouched for fewer than Num_Buckets (8) elements and its bucket sorts were not proved, so Sort was correct (and proved) only through the final Bubble_Finish; tests/phase_alone.sh (own property checks with the Bubble_Finish call removed) failed at N = 2 (fallback hides the named algorithm, pattern 7). Fixed with in-place buckets whose sortedness is proved; Bubble_Finish removed

named phase does not sort; output correct only via fallback bubble sort: Library_Phase left 48,020 of 200,000 generated clustered arrays unsorted (left shift wrote X one slot too far right; with that patched 23,580 were still unsorted), and Sort was correct (and proved) only through the final Bubble_Finish; existing tests never packed a band of values, so they passed. Fixed by a rewritten library phase (gap-skipping binary search, shift right to the nearest free slot, spread to odd slots after 1, 2, 4, .. insertions) proved to sort without Bubble_Finish (275 checks)

Newton_Solver returned steps that satisfy neither of Freund's equations (5 of 300 data sets, residual 1.43 of 2.11 at round 1): undamped Newton left the basin, and plain F1**2 + F2**2 backtracking ran alpha off to ~7.6e14 where every factor underflows

when no t in [0, s] conserves the potential, Newton stopped at a non-root (alpha 0.68 instead of the root 0.65, AA_SEED=2) and used a smaller minimum step than the bisection variant (0 only when T <= 0; AA_SEED=5 trained a round with no positive advantage)
deferred shading dropped the ambient color, specular color and diffuse coefficient, so it differed from forward shading of the same fragment in 20 of 30 scenes

Pre contracts on Normalize, Triangle_Face_Normal and the shading variants duplicated the conditions the bodies raise as Zero_Vector_Error and Degenerate_Geometry_Error, so with contracts checked (-gnata) the documented exceptions were unreachable
Update and Finalize had Pre => Is_Initialized, so an uninitialized context raised Assertion_Error instead of the documented State_Error
Train indexed the labels with the feature-row index, so a Labels_Array with another index origin raised Constraint_Error

Forward_Haar_1D_Lossless stored even-odd and even-(diff/2) with Ada truncating division, so it was not the S-transform. On (5, 2) it returned average 4 and detail 3; floor((5+2)/2) is 3 and the detail is 2-5 = -3. Negatives only had a round-trip check, which the wrong pair still passed (own S-transform; pattern 5).

The integer step still formed x+y and used (N-1)/2 for floor. (Integer'Last, Integer'Last) overflowed the sum, and a detail of Integer'First overflowed N-1. A detail of 2**31 does not fit in Integer. Fixed by the lifting step d=y-x, s=x+floor(d/2), floor via even/odd (no N-1), and Long_Integer coefficients.
Draw_Index scaled a digits-12 unit interval, so one-center Forgy over-picked the last row (chi-square 99 on 4000 seeds, 20 rows)
State mod Span uses the LCG low bits, so a span of 2 alternates (0 matches in 3999 pairs). Index is now State / (Bound / Span) after rejection.

tests.adb started Root = 1 on an empty tree; Insert then linked node 1 to itself (Rights (1) = 1) and its 16-step cap silently dropped node 3, while the test only checked Root = 1. Insert now requires a well-formed tree and a fresh node, the cap and the silent unused-node branch are gone, and a loop variant proves the walk ends

Can_Finish was a stub: it returned Prerequisites (1).Required = 1 and never looked at the graph, so the 2-cycle 1 -> 2 -> 1 (first pair requiring course 1) was reported finishable. Replaced by Kahn's algorithm with a proved witness (order or stuck set) and a proof that the two cannot coexist

Find_Maximum_Index returned a non-maximum on non-strict unimodal input (which the spec allows): on A (M1) = A (M2) it narrowed to [M1, M2], but with plateaus the maximum can lie outside, e.g. [0 0 0 0 0 0 0 1] and [1 0 0 0 0 0 0 0] gave index 3 (value 0); 128 of the unimodal arrays over 0 .. 2 up to length 8 were wrong. Found by the cost scan (agent B). Now narrows to M1 + 1 .. M2 - 1 only when the array rises after M1 or falls before M2 (always so for strictly unimodal input, which stays O(log N)), else scans the window (O(N) worst case with plateaus, documented)

Probes under-counted (agent B's own 2026-10-09 rewrite, found by agent B in the records review): on equal ends Find_Minimum makes a second comparison of two elements (Values (Hi - 1) > Values (Hi)) that was not counted, so an all-equal array reported 7 comparisons instead of 14 and the proved Probe_Count 0 .. N - 1 understated the O(N) worst case. Now counted; Probe_Count 0 .. 2 * (N - 1) proved via Probes + 2 * (Hi - Lo) <= 2 * (N - 1); tests check exact counts on all-equal and all-equal-but-one arrays (counts worked by a step model, three checked by hand)

Probes under-counted (agent B's own 2026-10-09 rewrite; same defect as Find-Minimum-II): the equal-ends check Data (Hi - 1) > Data (Hi) in the turn search was not counted, so an all-equal array reported 38 comparisons instead of 69. Now counted; turn search 0 .. 2 * (N - 1) and Probe_Count 0 .. 2 * (N - 1) + 8 proved; exact-count tests added first

V&V validity, own rewrite (agent B, 2026-10-09): the first rewrite (2dc1d175) built the ghost Ways table by the recurrence at package elaboration. Under -gnata its checks ran in every program that withs the package, so the mutation dummy run killed 14/35 mutants of that ghost code without calling anything (the dummy must score 0) and the first mutation run (split 20261078) is invalid. Fixed by a ghost expression-function table checked against the recurrence by Lemma_Facts inside Count and Climb (nothing runs at elaboration); the rerun uses new seeds and is labelled not blind.

description: tests.adb Is_Max_Heap used 1-based children (2 * I, 2 * I + 1), so on arrays with A'First /= 1 it compared the wrong elements and accepted non-heaps (checker scan, exhaustive vs independent definition; tools/vv/checker_scan.csv)
Is_Subtree accepted a matching node that is not reachable from Root (checker scan; tools/vv/checker_scan.csv)

Spec_Balanced / Is_Balanced (the Post) accept link structures where both children are the same node or nodes are shared (3534 of 394806 structures on 1..4 nodes); functional_checks claim withdrawn in PROOFS.csv; folder claimed by main-heldout-alt, reported not fixed (tools/vv/checker_scan.csv)

Is_Safe required every process's whole need to fit in Available at the same time instead of running the Banker's safety algorithm (finish in some order, returning allocations), so states that are safe through a finishing order were judged unsafe and such Requests refused (README: Bankers resource-allocation safety checks)
Fault_Count_Type was 0 .. 100 and Access_Page skipped the increment at the top, so after 100 faults the count silently stayed at 100 (saturating clamp); now Natural with a precondition

Defang wrote into a 32-character output: once it filled up the rest of the input was dropped silently, and a '.' arriving with 30 or 31 characters written was copied without brackets (two silent clamps); output is now 3 * 32 characters with Post Output_Length in Length .. 3 * Length
